serverInfo.name: cookie-cyber-team
serverInfo.description: Single Unified Intelligent MCP Server, Defensive Guardrails & Cyber Defense System for autonomous vulnerability remediation, inter-procedural taint flow analysis, air-gapped binary triage, and zero-regression safe patch verification.

tools.name: mcp_adaptive_guide
tools.description: Adaptive Meta-Guide and Cognitive Anchor. Discovers project genome (<5ms) and outputs optimal tool call sequence, active guardrail rules, exact targeted test commands, and prohibited actions tailored to task intent.

active_file.description: Optional file path currently being inspected or edited to generate targeted test commands.

tools.name: mcp_scan_vulnerabilities
tools.description: Performs SAST security scan using Pure-Python AST Engine (CWE-78, CWE-89, CWE-95, CWE-502, CWE-798, CWE-295, CWE-22, CWE-327, CWE-328, CWE-377, CWE-352, CWE-611, CWE-918, CWE-79, CWE-1336, CWE-943, CWE-400), Call Graph Taint Analysis, Delta Git scanning, CVSS scoring (v3.1 & v4.0), and OASIS SARIF v2.1.0 export.

target_path.description: Absolute or relative path to file to scan.

code_content.description: Optional in-memory code string to scan directly.

delta_only.description: If true, scans only modified lines from git diff.

base_commit.description: Base Git commit for diff comparison (default: 'HEAD').

use_semgrep.description: If true, enables Semgrep multi-language adapter.

output_format.description: Output report format: 'json' (default) or 'sarif' (OASIS SARIF v2.1.0 standard).

tools.name: mcp_audit_dependencies
tools.description: Performs offline Software Composition Analysis (SCA) on workspace dependency files (requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, poetry.lock) against curated offline OSV JSON vulnerability database.

path.description: Optional directory or dependency file path to audit (defaults to workspace root).

tools.name: mcp_execute_sandbox_test
tools.description: Executes unit or regression tests under strict isolated sandbox (zero shell=True, env whitelist, Windows process tree termination, optional Docker).

test_path.description: Path to test script to execute.

tools.name: mcp_create_reproduction_test
tools.description: Generates and validates a minimal reproduction test under Step 1 of Hypothesis-Driven Debugging (verifies test fails before fix).

save_path.description: File path where reproduction test is written.

test_code.description: Python test code reproducing the defect.

vulnerability_type.description: Identified vulnerability type or CWE ID.

tools.name: mcp_preview_surgical_patch
tools.description: Dry-run preview of surgical patch application. Validates Gate 1.5 (Ponytail linter: dead code, stdlib preference), Gate 2 (Diff Cap <=50 lines), Gate 4 (Zero-Deletion invariant), and returns generated unified diff without modifying disk.

target_file.description: File path to apply the preview patch to.

hunks.description: List of hunk objects: [{'start_line': int, 'end_line': int, 'target_content': str, 'replacement_content': str}].

unified_diff.description: Standard unified diff string (--- a/ +++ b/ @@ ...).

patched_content.description: Complete new content for the target file.

tools.name: mcp_apply_safe_patch
tools.description: Applies source code patch protected by 5 safety guardrails: Single-Committer authority, Gate 1.5 Ponytail Linter (Dead code, stdlib priority), Diff Cap (<=50 lines), Zero-Regression SAST, and Gate 4 Zero-Deletion.

target_file.description: File path to apply the patch to.

hunks.description: List of hunk objects: [{'start_line': int, 'end_line': int, 'target_content': str, 'replacement_content': str}].

unified_diff.description: Standard unified diff string (--- a/ +++ b/ @@ ...).

patched_content.description: Complete new content for the target file.

committer.description: Agent persona applying the patch. Only 'Lead Orchestrator' is authorized (Single-Committer Gate).

committer_token.description: Ephemeral capability session token issued to Lead Orchestrator for authorized patch application.

tools.name: mcp_orchestrate_dag
tools.description: Manages Multi-Agent DAG tasks and Point-to-Point Mailbox (Lead Orchestrator, Security Auditor, Debugger, Patch Developer, QA Reviewer, SOC Incident Responder).

action.description: Action to perform on DAG workflow or Mailbox.

include_soc.description: Include SOC Incident Responder in pipeline.

status.description: New status for task state transition.

value.description: Shared context JSON or string value.

agent_id.description: Agent identifier to check inbox or drainage.

tools.name: mcp_search_code
tools.description: Surgical code search using Semble-style tokenization, syntactic method/skeleton chunking, and SQLite FTS5 BM25. Returns targeted chunks (<100 tokens).

query.description: Search query keywords or function/class symbols.

target_path.description: Target file or directory path to index and search.

top_k.description: Maximum number of chunks to return (default: 5).

tools.name: mcp_triage_binary
tools.description: Air-Gapped Binary Triage under Zero-Execution Policy. Dissects PE/ELF/ZIP/DEX magic headers, 1KB block Shannon entropy, and safe string IOCs.

file_path.description: Path to binary artifact to triage safely.

tools.name: mcp_run_diagnostic_tool
tools.description: Safely executes a whitelisted host diagnostic or reverse engineering tool ('strings', 'readelf', 'objdump', 'cfr', 'jadx', 'r2', 'radare2') against a target file under strict sandbox isolation and input sanitization.

target_file.description: Path to binary or target file to inspect.

args.description: Optional list of CLI arguments (forbidden shell metacharacters are strictly rejected).

tools.name: mcp_submit_dynamic_sandbox
tools.description: Submits a suspicious binary to an external isolated dynamic analysis sandbox (CAPEv2 / Cuckoo REST API) or polls task status non-blockingly via async_mode and check_status_task_id.

file_path.description: Path to binary artifact to submit for dynamic execution analysis.

async_mode.description: If true, submits file and returns task_id immediately without blocking for 120s.

task_id.description: Poll status or retrieve report for a previously submitted task ID without re-submitting.

tools.name: mcp_quarantine_artifact
tools.description: Automated artifact quarantine under Zero-Execution Policy. Atomically moves suspicious binary into encrypted/obfuscated vault (.quarantine/), strips execute permissions, and records SHA-256 evidence manifest.

file_path.description: Path to the suspicious file or malware sample to quarantine.

quarantine_dir.description: Optional custom quarantine directory (defaults to .quarantine/ in workspace).

tools.name: mcp_restore_quarantined_file
tools.description: Restores a previously quarantined file from the encrypted/obfuscated vault back to its original destination or workspace.

quarantine_path.description: Path to the quarantined encrypted file in the vault.

original_destination.description: Optional path where the file should be restored. If omitted, restored to original location recorded in manifest.

tools.name: mcp_generate_containment_rule
tools.description: Generates host containment and firewall rules across Windows Defender Firewall (netsh), Linux iptables, Linux UFW, and DNS sinkhole formats to block malicious C2 IPs or domains.

target.description: Malicious IP address, CIDR subnet, or C2 domain name to block.

port.description: Optional port number (1-65535) for port-specific firewall filtering.

tools.name: mcp_terminate_process
tools.description: Safely terminates a suspicious or rogue process and its entire descendant child process tree (using taskkill /T on Windows, process groups / SIGKILL on Linux) under containment protocols.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds to wait for graceful termination before force killing (default: 3.0).

tools.name: mcp_ponytail_review
tools.description: Reviews code or diff against the Ponytail 7-Rung Decision Ladder, tagging findings with delete:, stdlib:, native:, yagni:, shrink: and estimating LOC reduction.

code.description: Source code snippet to review against Ponytail rules.

file_path.description: Optional file path to load code from or provide file context.

diff.description: Optional unified diff string to review.

tools.name: mcp_ponytail_audit
tools.description: Audits repository workspace files for dead code, unneeded dependencies, and AST YAGNI violations, ranking files by potential LOC reduction.

path.description: Target workspace directory or file to audit (defaults to workspace root).

tools.name: mcp_ponytail_debt
tools.description: Scans workspace for ponytail: debt comments (# ponytail: or // ponytail:) and compiles a structured Debt Ledger.

path.description: Target directory to scan for ponytail debt comments (defaults to workspace root).

tools.name: mcp_validate_finding
tools.description: Apply the deterministic 7-Question validation gate to suppress false positives. Returns a verdict (submit/investigate/discard), a confidence score, reproducible replay steps, and de-duplicated findings.

tools.name: mcp_recall_findings
tools.description: Persistent finding memory: recall remembered findings, compute stats, dismiss noise by fingerprint, or run dedupe / rank / attack-chain analysis.

tools.name: mcp_plan_scan
tools.description: Decompose a workspace into focused, prioritized, dependency-ordered security tasks; optionally seed the multi-agent DAG pipeline.

tools.name: mcp_technique_lookup
tools.description: Look up ATT&CK technique signatures by id, tactic, or free-text match against a curated, data-only catalog of offensive primitives expressed as defensive detection signatures.

tools.name: mcp_attack_path
tools.description: Attack-path reasoning: place observed techniques on the ATT&CK kill chain, infer likely next tactics, and surface the highest-value detections and remediation steps.

tools.name: mcp_export_bundle
tools.description: Build and optionally write a report bundle: ranked findings, attack chains, OASIS SARIF 2.1.0, STIX 2.1 / MAEC 5.x indicators, a Markdown report, and submission templates.

tools.name: mcp_orchestrate
tools.description: Meta-orchestrator: turns a single high-level intent (auto/audit_repo/review_code/triage_binary/dependency_audit/incident_response/skill_audit/agentic_audit) into a coordinated, dependency-aware sequence of the other tools, threading each step's output into the next and withholding all write steps unless allow_write=true.

tools.name: mcp_import_skills
tools.description: Ingests a local Agent Skills (SKILL.md) knowledge tree into memory. Offline and optional: degrades gracefully when no tree exists.

tools.name: mcp_skills_lookup
tools.description: Search and inspect the ingested Agent Skills (SKILL.md) knowledge catalog by keyword, security domain, or framework tag.

tools.name: mcp_audit_agent_skills
tools.description: Audits skills, MCP manifests, and agent configs for agentic threat patterns; returns ranked findings, a tamper-evident audit receipt, and optional generated egress-block rules.

tools.name: mcp_framework_lookup
tools.description: Look up ATT&CK v19.1 tactics (Stealth / Defense Impairment split), D3FEND countermeasures, ATLAS techniques, NIST CSF 2.0, NIST AI RMF, and MITRE F3 fraud tactics; pass a technique_id for a cross-framework mapping.

tools.name: mcp_detection_coverage
tools.description: Report ATT&CK v19.1 detection coverage across the registered SOC rule set: per-tactic technique coverage, gaps, and unmapped techniques.

resources.name: CookieCyberTeam Security Standards & Defensive Guardrails
resources.description: Standard checklist for CWE-78, CWE-89, CWE-95, CWE-502, CWE-798, CWE-295, file protection invariants, and zero-trust conventions.

resources.name: 4-Step Hypothesis-Driven Debugging Protocol
resources.description: Scientific debugging mindset: Reproduce -> Trace & Isolate -> Form Hypothesis -> Confirm via Proof & Minimal Diff.

resources.name: Multi-Agent Shared State & DAG Overview
resources.description: Dynamic SQLite WAL shared memory containing pipeline status, task graph, and findings.

resources.name: Host Defensive & Reverse Engineering Toolchain Index
resources.description: Dynamic inventory of security, SAST, reverse engineering, and sandbox tools available on host system.

resources.name: NIST SP 800-61 Rev 3: Malware Triage & Reverse Engineering Playbook
resources.description: Standard procedures for Zero-Execution air-gapped triage, PE/ELF magic header parsing, Shannon entropy, and string IOC extraction.

resources.name: Multi-Agent Compromise Assessment & Agentic Threats Playbook
resources.description: Server containment, unauthorized file deletion prevention, single-committer isolation, and OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Systems.

resources.name: CookieCyberTeam Project Genome Profile
resources.description: Sub-5ms discovery of project language, frameworks, test runners, git status, risk profile, and adaptive recommendations.

resources.name: CookieCyberTeam Active Security Guardrails & Gate Policies
resources.description: Active runtime configuration of all 5 Zero-Trust Guardrail Gates (Syntax, Ponytail Linter, Diff Cap, SAST, Zero-Deletion).

resources.name: Ponytail The Lazy Senior Dev Decision Ladder & Native Playbook
resources.description: 7-Rung decision ladder, standard library / native API lookup tables, and intensity mode specifications.

resources.name: ATT&CK Technique Signature Catalog
resources.description: Curated, data-only catalog of offensive technique primitives expressed as defensive detection signatures, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK techniques and tactics.

resources.name: Malware Family Intelligence Catalog
resources.description: Descriptive traits, ATT&CK mappings, and detection markers for catalogued malware families (no samples, no offensive code).

resources.name: ATT&CK Kill-Chain Stage Model
resources.description: Ordered ATT&CK tactic kill chain used for attack-path reasoning and next-step prioritization.

resources.name: Agent Skills (SKILL.md) Knowledge Catalog
resources.description: Ingested SKILL.md skills with domain and six-framework tags, plus library statistics. Offline, data-only.

resources.name: Multi-Framework Security Catalog
resources.description: ATT&CK v19.1 tactics (Stealth / Defense Impairment split), D3FEND countermeasures, ATLAS techniques, NIST CSF 2.0, NIST AI RMF, and MITRE F3 fraud tactics.

resources.name: Agentic Threat Taxonomy & Defensive Controls
resources.description: ASI-0X agentic threat classes with the audit heuristic catalog and handling guidance.

resources.name: ATT&CK Detection Coverage Matrix
resources.description: Per-tactic ATT&CK v19.1 coverage of the registered SOC rule set, including gaps and unmapped techniques.

prompts.name: mcp_prompt_orchestrator
prompts.description: Lead Orchestrator: Decomposes security issues into an acyclic DAG, manages mailbox routing, and enforces single-committer gates.

prompts.name: mcp_prompt_security_audit
prompts.description: Security Auditor: Maps attack surface, scans AST for CWEs, and assigns FIRST CVSS v3.1 vectors.

prompts.name: mcp_prompt_hypothesis_debug
prompts.description: Scientific Debugger: Executes 4-step hypothesis method and builds minimal reproduction test.

prompts.name: mcp_prompt_safe_patch
prompts.description: Patch Developer: Drafts minimal diff (<=50 lines) adhering to Ponytail Principle.

prompts.name: mcp_prompt_qa_review
prompts.description: QA / Code Reviewer: Runs isolated sandbox tests and enforces Zero-Regression SAST.

prompts.name: mcp_prompt_soc_incident_responder
prompts.description: SOC Incident Responder: Coordinates triage under NIST SP 800-61 Rev 3, performs air-gapped binary triage, and isolates IOCs.

arguments.name: artifact_path
arguments.description: Path to suspicious file or binary.

prompts.name: mcp_prompt_ponytail_review
prompts.description: Senior Pragmatic Reviewer: Audits code/diff against Ponytail 7-Rung Ladder, tagging findings with delete:, stdlib:, native:, yagni:, shrink:.

prompts.name: mcp_prompt_ponytail_minimalist
prompts.description: Minimalist Code Generator: Generates the shortest working diff strictly prioritizing stdlib/native features and zero speculative code.

arguments.name: task_description
arguments.description: Task or bug requirement to implement.

prompts.name: mcp_prompt_bug_bounty_report
prompts.description: Finding Validator & Report Writer: runs the 7-Question Gate on candidate findings, discards weak ones, and drafts submission-ready reports for the survivors.

arguments.name: target_file
arguments.description: Target source file or path under review.

arguments.name: finding
arguments.description: Optional finding description to validate and report.

prompts.name: mcp_prompt_investigation_ptt
prompts.description: Investigation Lead: builds and drives a Pentesting Task Tree (reasoning/generation/parsing roles), reasons over the ATT&CK kill chain, and persists the investigation plan.

arguments.name: observed_techniques
arguments.description: Comma-separated ATT&CK technique ids already observed.

prompts.name: mcp_prompt_agentic_defender
prompts.description: Agentic Threat Defender: audits skills, MCP manifests, and agent configs for prompt injection, over-broad tool grants, exfiltration, and sandbox-escape risk.

arguments.name: target_path
arguments.description: Skill/config tree or artifact to audit.

arguments.name: asi_id
arguments.description: Optional ASI-0X threat class to focus on.

prompts.name: mcp_prompt_skill_curator
prompts.description: Skill Curator: ingests a SKILL.md knowledge tree, indexes framework tags, and surfaces the skills relevant to an investigation.

arguments.name: domain
arguments.description: Optional security domain to focus on.
